title: Lambda Functions from C#
description: Create and invoke Lambda functions with the AWSSDK.Lambda package.

data.text: AWS Lambda runs your code in response to events without provisioning servers. The AWSSDK.Lambda package lets you create, update, and invoke functions programmatically from C#.
Create and Invoke a Lambda Function

data.title: Lambda Handler Pattern
data.text: Lambda functions in C# are usually static methods that accept an event type and return a response. The AWS.Lambda.Core NuGet package provides the ILambdaContext for logging and configuration.

data.title: Deploy a Lambda function from CI/CD
data.description: Package a C# Lambda and deploy it from a build pipeline.
steps: Create a Lambda function project using Amazon.Lambda.Templates
Publish the function as a zip
Use the AWS SDK to create or update the function
Invoke the function with a test payload
data.expectedOutcome: The function is created in AWS and returns the expected result when invoked.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Lambda runs code without managing servers
Use the AWS SDK to automate deployments
Handler signature determines the event input type
IAM roles grant the function access to other services
data.takeaway: Lambda turns isolated C# methods into scalable, event-driven cloud services.
